Class ChaosAgentExtension

java.lang.Object
com.macstab.chaos.jvm.testkit.ChaosAgentExtension
All Implemented Interfaces:
org.junit.jupiter.api.extension.AfterEachCallback, org.junit.jupiter.api.extension.AfterTestExecutionCallback, org.junit.jupiter.api.extension.BeforeEachCallback, org.junit.jupiter.api.extension.BeforeTestExecutionCallback, org.junit.jupiter.api.extension.Extension, org.junit.jupiter.api.extension.InvocationInterceptor, org.junit.jupiter.api.extension.ParameterResolver
public final class ChaosAgentExtension extends Object implements org.junit.jupiter.api.extension.BeforeEachCallback, org.junit.jupiter.api.extension.BeforeTestExecutionCallback, org.junit.jupiter.api.extension.AfterTestExecutionCallback, org.junit.jupiter.api.extension.AfterEachCallback, org.junit.jupiter.api.extension.InvocationInterceptor, org.junit.jupiter.api.extension.ParameterResolver
JUnit 5 extension that integrates the chaos agent into the JUnit lifecycle, providing per-test chaos isolation through ChaosSession scoping.

Usage

@ExtendWith(ChaosAgentExtension.class)
class MyServiceTest {

    @Test
    void shouldHandleDelays(ChaosSession session) {
        session.activate(delayScenario);
        try (ChaosSession.ScopeBinding scope = session.bind()) {
            // chaos is active on this thread
            myService.call();
        }
    }
}

Lifecycle

  • Before each test (beforeEach(ExtensionContext)): ensures the chaos agent is installed (self-attaching if necessary via ChaosPlatform.installLocally()), then opens a fresh ChaosSession scoped to the test's display name. The ChaosControlPlane and ChaosSession are stored in the JUnit ExtensionContext store.
  • Around the test method: beforeTestExecution(ExtensionContext) activates the scenarios declared with WithChaos on the test class, the classes a @Nested test class runs inside, and the method, after the test's @BeforeEach methods; the thread that runs the test method (or a dynamic test) is bound to the session while it runs, so session-scoped ones reach the test body; afterTestExecution(ExtensionContext) stops them before the test's @AfterEach methods.
  • After each test (afterEach(ExtensionContext)): closes the session, which stops all session-scoped scenarios and releases any session-bound threads. The session is removed from the store to prevent cross-test leakage.

Parameter injection

The extension implements ParameterResolver and can inject the following parameter types into test methods and lifecycle methods:

  • ChaosSession — the session opened for the current test
  • ChaosControlPlane — the JVM-wide control plane, useful for activating JVM-scoped scenarios

Thread safety

Each test gets its own ChaosSession. Parallel test execution is supported as long as tests use session-scoped scenarios; JVM-scoped scenarios are shared across all threads and parallel tests must be aware of this.

    • afterEach

      public void afterEach(org.junit.jupiter.api.extension.ExtensionContext context)
      Closes the ChaosSession that was opened for this test, stopping all session-scoped scenarios and unbinding any bound threads.

      The session is removed from the store before closing to prevent it from being used after this point. If beforeEach(ExtensionContext) did not complete (e.g., due to an earlier setup failure), this method is a no-op.

      Specified by:
      afterEach in interface org.junit.jupiter.api.extension.AfterEachCallback
      Parameters:
      context - the JUnit extension context for the test that just finished

    • resolveParameter

      public Object resolveParameter(org.junit.jupiter.api.extension.ParameterContext parameterContext, org.junit.jupiter.api.extension.ExtensionContext extensionContext)
      Resolves the parameter value from the extension context store.

      Returns the ChaosSession or ChaosControlPlane stored during beforeEach(ExtensionContext). The returned object is keyed and typed by the parameter's class, so the correct instance is retrieved without a cast.

      Specified by:
      resolveParameter in interface org.junit.jupiter.api.extension.ParameterResolver
      Parameters:
      parameterContext - the context for the parameter to be resolved
      extensionContext - the JUnit extension context for the test
      Returns:
      the resolved parameter value
      Throws:
      org.junit.jupiter.api.extension.ParameterResolutionException - outside a test, its @BeforeEach and @AfterEach methods: the session is opened per test
